resources.string: Lets FRIDAY use apps on this phone when you ask: it reads the app on screen (its non-password text and a screenshot), then taps, types and scrolls in it. FRIDAY asks before using each app, and before sending, buying or deleting. A banner shows which app FRIDAY is using, with a Stop button. What FRIDAY sees is shared with the current chat model. You can turn this service off at any time in Accessibility settings.
